label: PF Backlog 231
title: Capability-aware request builder (apply capabilities per call)
body: Build each LLM request from the agent's capability vector INTERSECT the model's catalog capabilities: set reasoning_effort/thinking budget only when needed+supported, response_format=json_schema(strict) when needed+supported, pass only the agent's relevant tool subset, trim context. Where the model lacks a needed capability -> route to a capable candidate or degrade+flag+suggest. Owner: core/orchestrator/llm_client.py + model_router.py.
_note: Slice1: build_request enables a capability only when the model supports it (degrade+flag). model_gate consumes the vector. Wiring into llm_client per call = later slice.
